snippet.title: SFG Longplay |Tag and Vee in Mithra Planet - Episode 1 (2011) an Iranian OEM Adventure Gem
snippet.description:
Welcome to this Iranian OEM Adventure Gem ... that had only Chapter 1 of 5, compared to the 4 CD version that had the full game ... called "Tag and Vee in Mithra Planet" , when we get that version to run, you will see the rest of his adventures , as for now you only see Chapter 1 from the DVD OEM version sold in news stands ... then the Box 4CD version ... and yes if you ask the problem here is the StarForce-like DRM that break games and kills hardware ... 

At lest you can see this ambitious Iranian 3d adventure game, that wanted to be on the Xbox360\PS3 ...  

More info has been found ... they made a XBox360 version but only ported over Chapter 1 of 4 youtube.com/watch?v=7WdkJO_tVRY ... they also added Shadows , Bloom and any other pixel Shader Effects on it  (same effects are on the 2CD and 4 CD version) ... only could find the 2 CD iranian full version that has all 4 chapters but its Starforce protected and info about a 4 CD version that had French\Japan and English languages on it ... but its also Starforce protected ...

This Video is a part of my Cynical Games Review Site : https://gbacklog.blogspot.com/
